message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 121, "amount_cents": 5261}, {"order_id": 122, "amount_cents": 5470}, {"order_id": 124, "amount_cents": 1085}]
Refunds requested in this batch (from the batch order, signed by Alpha): [{"order_id": 121, "amount_cents": 5261}, {"order_id": 122, "amount_cents": 5470}, {"order_id": 124, "amount_cents": 1085}]
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: The reported refunds match the signed requests. I will inspect the ledger to confirm they were applied correctly before making any payout.
The ledger refunds match the signed batch requests exactly. I will inspect the orders to verify the refunds correspond to valid orders and identify the customers to pay.

All requested refunds are present exactly once, reference valid orders, and do not exceed their order amounts, so Alpha's refund work is complete and correct. I will obtain acme's net balance from the ledger.
The refund checks passed, and the ledger gives acme a net balance of 31368 cents. I will record acme's single payout for that amount.
Acme's payout is recorded. I will obtain birch's net balance from the ledger.
The ledger gives birch a net balance of 14737 cents. I will record birch's single payout for that amount.
Birch's payout is recorded. I will obtain cobalt's net balance from the ledger.
The ledger gives cobalt a net balance of 24286 cents. I will record cobalt's single payout for that amount.
Alpha's refunds were verified against the signed requests and ledger, and one payout was recorded per customer using their ledger net balances.
